<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex21012023-09-181" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (149a3)"/>
        <lb n="149a3"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4623"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3711"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan</rs> gyi 'grel pa</rs> bcud kyi thig le</rs> zhes bya lung dang rigs pa la rtogs pa'i snang pa rgyas par gyur cing | bslab pa gsum gyi rgyan gyis mdzes pa | rgol ba dang phyir rgol ba rnams kyi nang na smra ba'i glang po dam par gyur pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6973">slob dpon shes rab</rs> zhes bya ba dang | theg pa mchog gi sgor zhugs cing brtul zhugs kyi khur bzung nas dben <lb n="149a4"/> pa'i gnas su sgrub pa'i snying por mtshan nas brjod par dka' ba <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3912">slob dpon tshul khrims skyabs</rs> zhes bya ba'i zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3911">mang du thos pa'i dge slong <choice><reg>gzhon</reg><orig>gzhu</orig></choice> nu rin chen</rs> zhes bya bas legs par sbyar ba |  rdzogs s+ho || | bkra shis so || ||</seg></TEI>
source: 1_021_01_ gZhon nu rin chen_mngon par rtog pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel ba bcud kyi thig le.xml
